_extractionComment: Extraction-calibration verdict floors (salience arc T7, judge-free two-sided guard; consumed ONLY by extraction-fidelity-eval.mjs --gate — the mq nightly reads `thresholds` and never sees this key). PINNED from 2 identical observation runs 2026-07-27 (2026-07-27-verdict-observation-run{1,2}.json): abstain pool 9/74 matched (matchRate 0.122; 74 = 66 stable noise twins + 8 empty-gold extraction-set rows; 2 unstable twins excluded), extract pool 56/56 (1.000; 12 durable twins + 12 collision-slice + 32 fact-bearing extraction-set rows). Re-pin recipe: floor = round3(observedMinMatchRate - 1.5/N) where observedMinMatchRate is the 3dp matchRate AS REPORTED in the run artifacts (0.122 - 1.5/74 => 0.102; using the exact fraction 9/74 instead gives 0.101 — the reported-3dp convention is the pinned one). Tolerates one verdict flip beyond the worst observed, breaches at two. The pool-size floors pin the DENOMINATORS at authoring size — fixture attrition, a dropped --fixture arg in the workflow, or mass unstable-flagging breaches as below_floor instead of silently re-scaling the rates (the mq gate's seedCount/stalenessTotal invariant, applied here; PR-180 review finding). These are REGRESSION TRIPWIRES around observed behavior at the shipping prompt — the noise floor is LOW because the shipping prompt re-admits production noise (the arc's measured finding; tightening was measured and rejected, see 2026-07-27-salience-baseline.md). NEVER weaken to go green; re-pin only with a committed 2-run re-measurement + rationale.
_undatedComment: Undated-arm G2 subset floor (undated-decay arc, plan Task 7.3; consumed ONLY by the --undated-arm entry point via --gate — the mq nightly reads `thresholds` and never sees this key). PINNED from the doubled before-arm 2026-08-07 (2026-08-07-undated-arm-run{1,2}.json, committed): G2 = recall@5 over the 24-row undated-gold subset = 1.000 in BOTH runs (zero dispersion on G2), arm size N=24. Zero dispersion -> no band, so the floor follows the extractionThresholds recipe pre-registered in the plan: floor = round3(observed_min - 1.5/N) = round3(1.000 - 0.0625) = 0.938. Tolerates one gold eviction (23/24 = 0.958 passes), breaches at two (22/24 = 0.917). The rows floor pins the DENOMINATOR at authoring size — fixture attrition or a swapped fixture breaches as below_floor instead of silently re-scaling the rate. Context the floor exists to interpret: at the shipped UNDATED_EFOLDINGS = 0.25 the captured headroom (min 1.4247x vs the policy's 1.284x demotion) makes an after-arm G2 of 1.000 arithmetically expected from a correct implementation, so a breach indicates an implementation defect (wrong-cohort or double application), not a magnitude call — full derivation and retention curve in issue #239. NEVER weaken to go green; re-pin only with a committed 2-run re-measurement + rationale.
_windowComment: Window-arm G2W subset floor (window-undated joint imputation plan, spec Sec7.3 step 4; consumed ONLY by the --window-arm entry point via --gate — the mq nightly reads `thresholds` and never sees this key). PINNED from the doubled before-arm 2026-08-12 (2026-08-12-window-arm-run{1,2}.json, committed): G2 = recall@5 over the 24-row undated-gold subset = 1.000 in BOTH runs (zero dispersion on G2), arm size N=24. Recipe pre-registered before the runs, both dispersion branches fixed in advance: zero dispersion -> floor = round3(observed_min - 1.5/N) (the extractionThresholds/undatedThresholds recipe, third use); non-zero dispersion -> STOP, investigate the variance source, re-run the doubled before-arm — a floor is pinned only from a zero-dispersion pair, deriving a band from an observed spread after the fact is banned (the p-hack the pre-registration exists to prevent). This pin is the zero-dispersion branch: floor = round3(1.000 - 1.5/24) = round3(0.9375) = 0.938. Tolerates one gold eviction (23/24 = 0.958 passes), breaches at two (22/24 = 0.917). The rows floor pins the DENOMINATOR at authoring size — fixture attrition or a swapped fixture breaches as below_floor instead of silently re-scaling the rate. Before-arm HEAD 0aa6bb3 (artifacts @ 35df520) — the code state both runs executed on, pre-policy (PR-W2 not yet merged). Regenerable-baseline recipe (DJ-12): `--window-arm --decay off` at N=24 reproduces the pre-policy window path byte-for-byte even after PR-W2 merges, keeping the factor-1.0 baseline regenerable forever for the #239 joint-retune re-validation and the Sec7.3 step 6 re-run obligation. DJ-4: a degenerate undatedFactor never becomes a hard filter or an inflation — anything outside (0, 1] falls back to 1 (today's behaviour); 0 is a silent hard filter, >1 is the #238 defect shape. DJ-8: a projection eviction is a STOP-and-return-to-#237, not a constant to unilaterally retune mid-arc — a unilateral retune would re-open the decay gate. Re-decision (owner-delegated, recorded on #237 2026-08-13): the doubled before-arm's in-process projection evicted w002:0 in BOTH runs (headroom min 1.259x vs the policy's 1.284x demotion; projected G2W 0.9583 vs this floor 0.938, which by its own recipe tolerates one eviction and breaches at two) — ACCEPTED as the single projected eviction, arc proceeds; the after-arm gate therefore tolerates zero further regressions. DJ-10: an after-arm breach reverts the (inert) policy PR and returns the measured G2W to #237/#239 — the floor is NEVER re-pinned downward. NEVER weaken to go green; re-pin only with a committed 2-run re-measurement + rationale.
